description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PatientService's allergy-related methods in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It tests functionalities such as retrieving, setting, updating, and voiding allergies and reactions for patients, verifying statuses, and manipulating allergy data structures.

classes.name: PatientServiceAllergyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing allergy functionality in PatientService within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: runBeforeAllTests
methods.description: Initializes the allergy service and loads test datasets before each test case.

methods.name: getAllergyByUuid_shouldGetAllergyByUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an allergy by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllergies_shouldGetTheAllergyListAndStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieving a patient's allergy list and their overall allergy status.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldSaveTheAllergyListAndStatus
methods.description: Tests saving new allergy data for a patient and verifying the updates.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidRemovedAllergiesAndMaintainStatusAsSeeListIfSomeAllergiesAreRemoved
methods.description: Tests voiding (removing) allergies and reactions, maintaining the allergy list and status.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllAllergiesAndSetStatusToUnknownIfAllAllergiesAreRemoved
methods.description: Tests voiding all allergies and setting status to 'Unknown'.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllAllergiesAndSetStatusToNoKnownAllergiesIfAllAllergiesAreRemovedAndStatusSetAsSuch
methods.description: Tests voiding all allergies and setting status to 'No Known Allergies'.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldSetStatusToNoKnownAllergiesForPatientWithoutAllergies
methods.description: Verifies setting 'No Known Allergies' status for a patient with no allergies.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedComment
methods.description: Tests voiding (voiding) an allergy when its comment is edited.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedSeverity
methods.description: Tests voiding an allergy when its severity is edited.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests voiding an allergy with a modified coded allergen.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests voiding an allergy after editing its non-coded allergen description.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithRemovedReactions
methods.description: Tests voiding an allergy after removing its reactions.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithAddedReactions
methods.description: Tests voiding an allergy after adding new reactions.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedReactionCoded
methods.description: Tests voiding an allergy after editing a reaction to be coded differently.

methods.name: setAllergies_shouldVoidAllergiesWithEditedReactionNonCoded
methods.description: Tests voiding an allergy after editing a reaction to be non-coded text.

methods.name: setTheNonCodedConceptForNonCodedAllergenIfNotSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that the non-coded concept is set appropriately for allergens without specified coded concepts.

methods.name: getAllergy
methods.description: Helper method to find an allergy by ID within an allergy list.
